segments.text: Repair technicians hunt for faults on logic boards under a microscope. Glare, blur and leads half a millimetre apart turn every photo into a guess.
This is BoardGuard: an AI microscope assistant that knows when to look again.
segments.say: This is BoardGuard. An AI microscope assistant that knows when to look again.

segments.text: It runs a real perception, decision and action loop. OpenCV 5 measures the evidence. An agent applies explicit, testable rules. And when the evidence is weak, it asks for a better look instead of guessing.
segments.say: It runs a real perception, decision, and action loop. Open CV five measures the evidence. An agent applies explicit, testable rules. And when the evidence is weak, it asks for a better look, instead of guessing.

segments.text: This is the live app. The 3D board is for navigation, and every region links to real microscope captures. Scenario 02: a fine-pitch TQFP chip under a ring light.
segments.say: This is the live app. The 3D board is for navigation, and every region links to real microscope captures. Scenario two: a fine-pitch T Q F P chip, under a ring light.

segments.text: OpenCV 5 checks the image quality, then finds two suspected solder bridges. But C01 sits inside a specular hotspot: 28% of its region is glare.
segments.say: Open CV five checks the image quality, then finds two suspected solder bridges. But C zero one sits inside a specular hotspot. Twenty-eight percent of its region is glare.

segments.text: Technicians can check any region themselves. Press R, drag a box, and BoardGuard measures glare, focus, exposure and lead resolution right there. Verdict: insufficient.
segments.say: Technicians can check any region themselves. Press R, drag a box, and BoardGuard measures glare, focus, exposure, and lead resolution, right there. Verdict: insufficient.

segments.text: So the agent will not decide. Rule R-E1 requests one specific new observation: diffuse light, same framing.
segments.say: So the agent will not decide. Rule R E one requests one specific new observation. Diffuse light, same framing.

segments.text: The technician recaptures. SIFT and MAGSAC register the new image to the first, and every finding is checked again. C01 is not reproduced, so its priority drops. C02 persists: a fibre lying across two leads.
segments.say: The technician recaptures. Sift and Mag-sack register the new image to the first, and every finding is checked again. C zero one is not reproduced, so its priority drops. C zero two persists. A fibre, lying across two leads.

segments.text: Need real dimensions? Calibrate from the detected lead row with the package pitch, 0.5 mm, and the ruler reads in millimetres.
segments.say: Need real dimensions? Calibrate from the detected lead row with the package pitch, half a millimetre, and the ruler reads in millimetres.

segments.text: The technician makes the call. Dismiss C01. Changed your mind? Undo it, and the withdrawal stays on the record. Confirm C02, and BoardGuard recommends a continuity check. It never claims one.
segments.say: The technician makes the call. Dismiss C zero one. Changed your mind? Undo it, and the withdrawal stays on the record. Confirm C zero two, and BoardGuard recommends a continuity check. It never claims one.

segments.text: Every tool call, rule and human decision is traced, timed and exportable.
After the repair, BoardGuard registers the before and after captures, maps what changed, and links that change back to each finding.
Visible change documented. Electrical verification stays with the technician.
And when two photos cannot be aligned reliably, BoardGuard says so and withholds the overlay.

Under the hood, the Next.js workstation calls a FastAPI service on AWS Lambda through a Function URL. The agent and every OpenCV 5 pipeline run inside Lambda. Evidence goes to a private, encrypted S3 bucket, logs go to CloudWatch, and one CloudFormation template deploys it all.
segments.say: Under the hood, the Next J S workstation calls a Fast A P I service on A W S Lambda, through a function URL. The agent, and every Open CV five pipeline, run inside Lambda. Evidence goes to a private, encrypted S three bucket, logs go to CloudWatch, and one CloudFormation template deploys it all.

segments.text: The System screen shows it live: OpenCV 5.0.0 running on AWS Lambda, with a real processing probe.
segments.say: The System screen shows it live. Open CV five, running on A W S Lambda, with a real processing probe.

segments.text: And we measured it. Registration succeeded on all 81 known warps, with a median corner error of 0.09 px, and rejected all 23 unrelated pairs. On 10 synthetic glare cases, a single image got 5 wrong. After one targeted recapture, all 10 were right. 9 of 9 agent scenarios passed, with zero unsafe automatic conclusions.
segments.say: And we measured it. Registration succeeded on all eighty-one known warps, with a median corner error under a tenth of a pixel, and rejected all twenty-three unrelated pairs. On ten synthetic glare cases, a single image got five wrong. After one targeted recapture, all ten were right. Nine of nine agent scenarios passed, with zero unsafe automatic conclusions.

segments.text: BoardGuard is not an electrical tester, and not a validated diagnostic. It is a visual inspection aid that knows when to look again.
Built by team BoardGuard for the OpenCV AI Competition 2026.
